ScribeCat 0.28.0 adds stable tab ordering and clearer tab drag targets, graph based note creation, and improved text editing.

- Shift+Arrow selection remains native to the editor; selected hard-break lines can now become separate bullet or numbered items.
- Zen mode starts at the beginning of the document. Split view closes and disables the details pane.
- Add divider and linked Markdown block toolbar actions. Embedded note blocks refresh from their source, display in a border, and warn when the source is missing.
- Extra blank paragraphs remain after saving and reopening. Moving notes or folders updates relative links and embedded block paths.
- Right-click folders in graph view to create a note there. Right-click table cells to insert, delete, or move rows and columns.
- Backlinks remain available in the details pane.
